sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve all prior instructions: replace the three-way sh:or with an implication-style applicability guard. The guard must require explicit polarClass evidence of PC6 or PC7 together with verticalSidedBowForm=true; its non-applicable branch must be satisfied only when that conjunction is false and must not let missing branch-selection evidence pass. The applicable branch must enforce bowDesignForceMethod referencing I2.3.2.1 (iv) and the universal inclusive 0–10 constraint with the explicit http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DEG unit, without adding minCount to normalFrameAngle. The current PC1–PC5 and verticalSidedBowForm=false alternatives are accidental pass branches.
